semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company produces precision vacuum components and electric heating products that are relevant to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: ShangHai HongDuan Precision Machine Co., Ltd. specializes in the development and production of precision machining and vacuum technology products, including components for vacuum coating equipment. Their offerings are tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on high-quality instrument accessories and electric heating solutions.
capabilities: Precision vacuum components for semiconductor manufacturing
Armored heating tubes and thermocouples for vacuum applications

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Shanghai and operates within the Yexie Industrial Park, focusing on both domestic and international markets.
